fields.Name: IT120 - Server-Set Query Parameters and Approvals
fields.Description: Server-transport bundle (#4789 A17). Creates a throwaway query whose ChapterID parameter is marked IsServerSet and approves it, then proves: a caller value for ChapterID (the only channel a GraphQL client has) is refused, naming it, and logged; server code sets it through RunQueryParams.ServerParameters; the approval is bound to a fingerprint of the definition, so editing the SQL to D2 without re-approval makes a RequireApproved run refuse while restoring D1 exactly makes it run again, and IsServerSet survives each SQL edit; and a template's Context.UserID renders the context user while a caller value for Context is refused and extraction keeps no Context parameter row; and approving needs the Queries: Approve authorization, so a UI-only user can save a draft but is refused when saving a query as Approved or approving the draft, which a holder then approves; and a draft that reads an entity row-filtered for the running user (MJ: AI Agent Runs for the UI role) is refused at run (also when read through a comma join after JOIN … ON), while a draft over no row-filtered entity runs and the same query runs once a holder approves it; and a UI-only user is refused when saving CacheValidationSQL, while a draft's validation SQL is never used by a cache check (it answers no_validation with fresh rows); and a UI-only user owns the queries they create (whatever owner they name), edits and deletes their own, cannot give one away or edit or delete another user's, and their edit to the SQL of an Approved query saves it as Pending. Self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A server-set parameter can only be set by server code; an approval is current only for the exact definition approved; Context comes from the server.
